note: Rustic campground at the southwest corner of 1,108-acre Plum Lake, between the lake and Plum Creek, with paved campground roads and an on-site host Memorial Day to Labor Day. The lake-side sites (1202-1205) look out through the trees; a foot path leads to a beach access and fishing pier. The Heart of Vilas County paved bike trail is nearby. --Claude
